channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran to announce restricted zone outside Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei says Tehran will announce a restricted zone around the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Eight-year-old Gaza girl killed by Israel on first day of school
item.description: An eight-year-old girl and her father were killed when an Israeli strike hit their vehicle on her first day of school.

item.title: North Korea deploys warship ‘capable of annihilating retaliatory strikes’
item.description: Leader Kim Jong Un says vessel will form part of Pyongyang's nuclear response system, strengthen naval forces.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran to announce new Hormuz shipping route in coming days
item.description: Move comes as Iran's top negotiator warns of heavier responses to new attacks after US strikes on Iranian oil tankers.

item.title: At least five killed after Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami airport
item.description: Five people are injured, and the cause of the crash is being investigated, authorities say.

item.title: At least 10 killed in central Mexico fireworks blast during festival
item.description: Local government says at least 60 were wounded in the blast, apparently caused by a burning bull effigy.

item.title: At least five killed in New Delhi building collapse
item.description: At least five people have been killed and nine rescued after a building housing mostly students collapsed in New Delhi.

item.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
item.description: The comments came a day after Washington said it had struck Iranian oil tankers in response to Tehran's attacks on US warships in the region.
